'''Open (100 cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>open_100_card</code>). It uses the same card pool as [[Open]], with a deck size of 100 cards and a default game timer of 90 minutes. Its format definition links to the Players Committee 100 Card Deck Format page and marks it as not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> The card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112. It also includes current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301).<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 100 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 100 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

== Players Committee page ==
The Players Committee describes the 100 Card Deck Format as a special format with 100 cards per deck. The per-player game timer is 90 minutes, instead of the 60 minutes of the usual 60-card format. The page says online play of the format on GEMP has been suspended indefinitely because of performance issues.<ref name="pc-100card" />
